description: This PHP source file defines a Drupal Views relationship plugin class 'GroupwiseMax' used for implementing groupwise maximum queries within Drupal's Views module. It includes methods for building options forms, generating subqueries, and handling query conditions, specifically for selecting a representative record per group based on sorting criteria.

classes.name: GroupwiseMax
classes.description: A Drupal Views relationship plugin class for handling groupwise maximum queries, allowing selection of a single representative record per group based on user-defined sorting criteria.

methods.name: defineOptions
methods.description: Defines default options for the relationship plugin, including sort and namespace settings.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for the relationship options, allowing users to select sorting criteria, order, namespace, and related views.

methods.name: getTemporaryView
methods.description: Creates a temporary Drupal View object for generating subquery SQL.

methods.name: submitOptionsForm
methods.description: Clears cache when options form is submitted to ensure updated subquery SQL.

methods.name: leftQuery
methods.description: Generates a subquery SQL string based on user options, creating or loading a view, adding handlers, and namespace adjustments.

methods.name: alterSubqueryCondition
methods.description: Recursively namespaces conditions in the subquery to prevent conflicts.

methods.name: conditionNamespace
methods.description: Adds namespace quoting to query condition parts, supporting PostgreSQL compatibility.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds the main relationship query, including handling cached subqueries and join creation.
